newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.148pts to 102.985.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.148pts to 102.985.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds rose 0.148 points in Tuesday's trading to 102.985, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.235 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, rose 0.196 points to 99.396, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.002 points to 2.196 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 fell 6.052 points to 1,044.387.
